QuestInfo.name: [NLC] The Final Clue
QuestInfo.0: Through Elpam's research, you uncovered the potential to find clues about the Antellion from the presence of Naricain's Blood all over Masteria. Talk to Elpam about his latest findings.
QuestInfo.1: Through Elpam's research, you learn that Naricain's Blood, which is spread all over Masteria, contains elements of the Antellion. Does Naricain's Blood condense, become Lianium, then turn into Antellion? And if so, does that mean the Antelllion could appear in this world again? Elpam says he needs Refined Lianium of higher purity so that he can study these questions further.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Refined Lianium to Elpam. What is the true nature of the connection between Lianium and the Antellion?

item.0: If you happen to come across some Refined Lianium, would you bring it to me?
